tools.name: get_latest_diff
tools.description: Latest changes in Japan's National Tax Agency corporate registry (houjin bangou): newly registered, changed, closed and revived companies from the daily diff. Mirrors the RegBase jp-diff-feed actor.

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Look up a Japanese company by 13-digit corporate number (exact) or by name substring (Japanese or English). Mirrors the RegBase jp-company-lookup actor.

tools.name: verify_signed_record
tools.description: Verify a RegBase Ed25519-signed company evidence record offline against the published T3 public key (key_id derived at runtime). Mirrors the jp-signed-record actor's verify action.

tools.name: get_snapshot_info
tools.description: Describe the bundled registry snapshot: record counts, as-of date and source.
